Higharc | REMOTE | Full-time | https://higharc.com

Thousands of homes have been built with Higharc since 2022. We’re changing the way homebuilders design, sell, estimate, and build, resulting in better, more affordable homes.

I’m starting a new Labs team to expand our platform and explore new markets in residential construction. I’m especially looking for a rare, entrepreneurial product engineer:

* Staff Software Engineer, Labs - https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/higharc/c620be3c-6529-4776-9f02-da1...

We’re also hiring across all teams, from fullstack generalists to ML engineers, keenly interested in folks looking for deep, technical challenges:

* Director of Engineering, Studio - https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/higharc/469e843e-58c4-4e07-91be-d9a...

* Senior Software Engineer, Geometric Modeling/CAD - https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/higharc/d5fbcbf0-0b50-4561-87e6-71c...

* More roles here https://www.higharc.com/company/careers

This is an exceptional opportunity to work on something with real-world impact, with a team of talented & passionate folks across a wide range of domains. We are ~200 people across the world (mostly US) and growing quickly. We were recently named to Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in 2026.

Thanks to everyone who previously reached out and/or applied (all 1300+ of you)
